regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, graphical abstract, and SI badge
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and generic current reaction class. Although SI availability is advertised, the workspace association is unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1 paths a and b
regions.finding: Path a is cited previous alkyne-forming work and is a literature example; path b is the generic unresolved/current allene-forming challenge, not an experiment-specific arrow with a yield.

regions.region: page 1 Results and Discussion initial ligand-screen prose
regions.finding: The narrative groups L1–L19 as no-product runs and reports L20/L21 outcomes; all 21 conditions are retained as independent Table 1 experiments linked to the page-2 drawings.

regions.region: page 1 beginning of Ming-Phos discussion
regions.finding: The L22 result introduces Table 2. The eleven ligand structures/outcomes are recorded separately from their page-2 drawings rather than as one aggregate experiment.

unresolved: The graphical abstract is a method summary and does not add a distinct run.

regions.region: page 2 left-column Table 1, all ligand drawings L1–L21, reaction arrow, and footnote
regions.finding: Twenty-one independent ligand-screen runs were recorded. L1–L19 explicitly give no desired product; L20 gives 76% NMR/2% ee and L21 gives 23%/35% ee under the depicted 9 h conditions.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 2, ligand drawings L22–L32, reaction arrow, and footnote
regions.finding: Eleven independent Ming-Phos rows were recorded. The arrow prints 35 °C/16 h while footnote a prints 30 °C; both facts and the unresolved conflict are retained for every row.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 3 and footnote
regions.finding: Nine palladium-source rows were recorded separately, including three slash/no-product rows and six numeric NMR-yield/ee outcomes under 30 °C/24 h/Ar conditions.

regions.region: page 2 right-column solvent/ligand optimization prose
regions.finding: Narrative results map to Tables 4–5 on page 3. A separate mixed c-hexane/MTBE, 0.5 equiv H2O, Pd(dmdba)2/L26 trial gives 24%/76% ee; unprinted Table S1 details remain missing. The subsequent 44% Pd2(dba)3 result maps to Table 6 entry 1 and is not duplicated.

unresolved: Table 2 temperature conflict remains 35 °C in the arrow versus 30 °C in the footnote.
The narrative mixed-solvent trial refers to unavailable Table S1; scale, loadings, time, temperature, atmosphere, and absolute solvent volumes are not reported.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 4 solvent rows 1–12 and footnote
regions.finding: Twelve distinct solvent-screen runs were retained with row-specific solvent, NMR yield and ee under the common 30 °C/24 h/Ar conditions.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Table 5 ligand drawings and footnotes
regions.finding: Eight distinct runs were retained: seven shared-condition ligand trials plus the separate L26 footnote-b run at 1.2 equiv 2a and 0.067 M. The two L26 outcomes were not merged.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Table 6 rows 1–7 and footnotes
regions.finding: Seven leaving-group conditions were retained separately. Entry 7 overrides 2a amount and palladium source/loading; reaction time is not printed and remains missing.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Table 7 ligand drawings L35–L46, further-variation table, and footnotes
regions.finding: Twelve ligand-screen runs and four further L46/Pd(dmdba)2 variations were recorded. L41 remains qualitative trace with the prose no-desired-product wording noted. The arrow's Ar and footnote's N2 atmosphere conflict is preserved.

unresolved: Table 7 atmosphere conflict remains Ar versus N2.
Table 7 scale-up entry 4 prints 2 equiv H2O without an absolute H2O amount; none was inferred.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Table 7 continuation prose
regions.finding: The text interprets the four L46/Pd(dmdba)2 variation rows and identifies the 2.5 equiv 1a/2 equiv H2O condition as optimal; these enrich the page-3 row records rather than forming narrative duplicates.

regions.region: page 4 left-center Scheme 2 three arrows
regions.finding: Three separate current-paper synthesis stages were recorded: Pd phosphination (83%), sulfinyl-imine condensation (80%), and -48 °C Grignard addition from 10 mmol imine to 4.80 g L46 (85%). Missing times and operations remain missing.

regions.region: page 4 upper-right Scheme 3 scope of boronic acids and footnotes
regions.finding: Fifteen successful boronic-acid rows and two separately named alkyl-boronic-acid failures were retained. Footnote-b temperature/time and footnotes-c/d NMR-yield/30 h overrides are row-specific.

regions.region: page 4 lower discussion of propargylic scope, ligand stereoisomers, and Diels–Alder use
regions.finding: The prose maps to Scheme 4's eleven successful/three failed substrate drawings, Scheme 5's four ligand stereoisomer runs, and Scheme 6's five two-step one-pot results on page 5; none are merged by product family.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits reaction times and several operational/yield-basis details.
Most Scheme 3/4 outcomes omit yield and ee analytical bases.
Failure detection limits and recovered starting material are not reported.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left Scheme 4 successful and failed substrate drawings with footnote
regions.finding: Eleven successful propargylic-benzoate scope arrows and three visually distinct no-product substrates were retained under the common 23 °C/24 h/N2 conditions. Compact uncertain structures remain label/descriptor candidates.

regions.region: page 5 left-center Scheme 5 four ligand stereoisomer arrows
regions.finding: Four separate standard-condition experiments were retained with product enantiomer, yield and ee: 74/93, 77/94, 61/89, and 61/89. Ligand stereoisomer changes are not merged.

regions.region: page 5 upper-right Scheme 6 panels a/b
regions.finding: Five one-pot sequences were retained. Their 60/53/41/45/21% values are explicitly overall two-step yields and are not assigned to the Diels–Alder stage alone; ee and dr are product-specific.

regions.region: page 5 mechanistic-study prose
regions.finding: The stated 35% ee of recovered 1a and positive nonlinear effect introduce Scheme 7 on page 6. They are recorded as experimental mechanistic studies, separate from the proposed Scheme 8 mechanism.

regions.region: page 5 proposed-mechanism discussion and conclusions
regions.finding: The oxidative-addition/transmetalation/reductive-elimination and axial-intermediate interconversion are proposed mechanisms; intermediates are not treated as isolated experiments. Conclusions add no new run.

unresolved: Scheme 6 omits Diels–Alder temperature and, for products 7/8, the second-stage time.
Scheme 7 intermediate graph coordinates were not converted to unsupported exact numbers.
Mechanistic intermediates remain proposed and generic.

regions.region: page 6 upper Scheme 7a recovered-1a plot
regions.finding: The time-course graph and page-5 prose support increasing recovered-1a ee and the explicitly stated approximately 35% final ee. Intermediate plotted points were not asserted as exact values.

regions.region: page 6 upper Scheme 7b nonlinear-effect plot
regions.finding: Two independent ligand-ee series at 3 h (yield about 10%) and 24 h (yield above 50%) show positive nonlinear effects. Exact graph coordinates were not fabricated.

regions.region: page 6 center Scheme 8a catalytic cycle
regions.finding: The L*nPd(0), (Ra)-I, II and III cycle is a proposed mechanism, not a set of isolated preparations.

regions.region: page 6 center Scheme 8b dynamic interconversion
regions.finding: The (S)-1/(R)-1 anti-SN2′ pathways and (Ra)/(Sa)/η3 intermediates are proposed stereochemical interconversion, not independent experimental products.

regions.region: page 6 Associated Content and author information
regions.finding: The page states online Supporting Information and CIF availability, but no associated SI file was explicitly provided in the workspace; no SI or CIF fact was imported as a reaction record.

unresolved: Exact Scheme 7 plotted coordinates and full experimental charges are not reported in the main text.
No additional reaction operation appears in author information.
